from pydantic.dataclasses import dataclass


StrictConfig = ConfigDict(
    anystr_strip_whitespace=True,
    validate_assignment=True,
)
", "explanation": "Pydantic V2 deprecates class-based `Config` and the class-based `config=` form (PydanticDeprecatedSince20, Migration Guide). Replacing the StrictConfig class with a ConfigDict with the same two settings, and importing ConfigDict. The `@dataclass(config=StrictConfig)` line is unchanged because it already accepts a ConfigDict. Behavior is the same: anystr_strip_whitespace and validate_assignment keep their values."}], "notes": "Fixed the deprecated class-based config (finding app/geo.py:9:test-failure). Not changed, but needs a human decision: `__post_init_post_parse__` is a Pydantic v1 pydantic-dataclass hook. Pydantic v2 does not call it, so the coordinate range check and the label title-casing in Point never run on the target version. v2 calls `__post_init__` instead, and renaming the hook would turn those checks back on. That is a behavior change, so it was left out of this scope. Also, the `StrictConfig` name is kept as a ConfigDict instance to keep the diff minimal."}
